newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - INSTITUTIONS BOOST TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - INSTITUTIONS BOOST TRADE.

text.p: boosted trade on the Botswana Stock Exchange last week.
